data.name: Honorine
data.gender_notes: Honorine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'honor', meaning 'reverence, honor'. This name was given to children as a wish for them to be honored and respected. In Christianity, Honorine is the name of several saints, including Honorine of Thebes and Honorine of Romans. The name Honorine carries the meaning “Honor, reverence” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Honorine usually hope their child will grow to embody honor, reverence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes respect, reverence, and honor for self and others.
data.etymology: Honorine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honor, reverence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Honorine total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: הונורין
in_hebrew.meaning: הונורין משמעות שם היא כבוד ויקר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הונורין הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו כבוד ויקר. השם הונורין הוא נגזרת של השם הלטיני Honorinus שפירושו איש כבוד או מקור כבוד. השם קשור למושג הכבוד וההערכה שמהם נובעים ערכים חשובים בחברה ובדת.

in_greek.name: Ονορίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ονορίνη έχει τις ρίζες του στη λατινική λέξη Honorinus, που σημαίνει άνθρωπος τιμής ή πηγή τιμής. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της τιμής και του σεβασμού, που αποτελούν θεμελιώδεις αξίες τόσο στην κοινωνία όσο και στη θρησκεία.

in_latin.name: Honorine
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Honorine originates from the Latin name Honorinus, meaning man of honor or source of honor. It is associated with the concept of honor and respect, which are fundamental values in both society and religion. The name reflects a person of dignity and integrity.

in_english.meaning: Honorine signifies a person of honor and dignity

The name inspires a sense of spiritual reverence and encourages the bearer to strive for virtuous qualities.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Honorine: Radiating dignity and respect, embodying the virtues of honor and grace. Inspired by the love of the Holy Trinity, her name evokes a life dedicated to upholding moral values and cherishing the worth of all beings.

historical_references.reference: Saint Honorine, a sixth-century virgin martyr from Brittany, is the patron saint of fishermen. According to legend, she lived in a cave near the sea and cared for the sick and the poor. She was discovered by Romans, who tried to force her to marry a nobleman. When she refused, she was tortured and eventually beheaded. Her relics were later taken to the island of Belle-Ile-en-Mer, where they are still venerated today.

Another Saint Honorine is the fifth-century saint from Arles, who is the patron saint of disputes and trials. She was a young girl who was falsely accused of stealing a silver cup. To prove her innocence, she asked to be tested by being buried up to her neck in the sand for three days. When she was exonerated, a spring of water emerged from the ground where she had been buried.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Honorine, with its elegant French origin, is experiencing a resurgence in popularity, particularly in the contexts of French names, vintage names, and nostalgic names. It can be found on various platforms such as Instagram, where users post photos of French-inspired interiors, fashion, and food, often featuring the name Honorine as an homage to its classic and timeless appeal. On Pinterest, users search for and save images of vintage-inspired baby names, with Honorine frequently appearing as a top choice for those seeking a name with a rich history and romantic feel. Finally, on Etsy, sellers offer a range of Honorine-themed products, including vintage-style stationery, home decor, and jewelry, appealing to consumers who appreciate the name's nostalgic and feminine qualities.
